decision: Four dated source observations accepted, not a continuous succession timeline.

holders.name: Harkishan Singh Surjeet
holders.note: Observed on 2 March 2004: People's Democracy of 7 March 2004 prints 'the text of the letter written by CPI(M) general secretary, Harkishan Singh Surjeet to the Chief Election Commissioner on March 2' (Internet Archive capture of the party organ on cpim.org); the earliest single-day party record adopted for him in the period.
holders.uncertainty: No start: the party's 2005 bio-data says he was elected General Secretary 'in 1992 at the 14th Party Congress held at Madras' and he wrote in 2005 of serving 'as the general secretary since 1992', both retrospective and without a day; the party's 2001 page recalls his re-election on 11 October 1998, a re-election that is not a start. No end: on 11 April 2005 the party organ calls him 'the former CPI(M) general secretary' and he wrote that Prakash Karat 'has taken up the mantle', neither stating the day he left the office; his successor's election is not used as his end.

holders.name: Prakash Karat
holders.note: Observed on 11 April 2005: People's Democracy of 17 April 2005 reports that at the public meeting in New Delhi on April 11 concluding the 18th Congress Surjeet 'was escorted to the podium by the newly-elected general secretary, Prakash Karat' (Internet Archive capture of the party organ).
holders.uncertainty: No start: the same issue says he 'has been unanimously elected' by the new Central Committee without a day. No end: he inaugurated the 21st Congress as 'general secretary of the CPI(M)' on 14 April 2015 and was 'the outgoing general secretary' on 19 April 2015; no record states the day he left the office, and his successor's election or observation is not used as his end. His interim coordinatorship of 2024-2025 is claims only and is not this office.

holders.name: Sitaram Yechury
holders.note: Observed on 19 April 2015: People's Democracy of 26 April 2015 reports that at the public meeting concluding the 21st Congress on April 19 the 'Newly elected general secretary, Sitaram Yechury, addressing the gathering' spoke (Internet Archive capture of the party organ). Until 12 September 2024: the Polit Bureau's statement records 'the passing away of Comrade Sitaram Yechury, General Secretary of the Party on September 12, 2024'.
holders.uncertainty: No start: the 21st Congress election of 19 April 2015 names nobody, the Polit Bureau list of the same issue has no day, and no record states the day he assumed the office. His re-elections at the 22nd (22 April 2018) and 23rd (10 April 2022) Congresses are claims, not new starts. The end is the day of death stated with the office in the party's own statement, the rule applied in CLAUDE-C01-34.

holders.name: M. A. Baby
holders.note: Observed on 12 May 2025: the party's release of that day says 'M. A. Baby, General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) has written a letter today to the Prime Minister' (party website record).
holders.uncertainty: No start: the party's post of 6 April 2025 says 'The Central Committee elected MA Baby as the General Secretary', an election claim dated by the post's dateline, and no record states the day he assumed the office. No end: he is styled General Secretary on 24 August 2026, and no vacancy, resignation or interim arrangement is recorded before the cutoff of 7 September 2026.

ems: Not established as an in-period or opening holder; undated former-office caption only.
karat_interim: Coordinator statements only, not a second general-secretary tenure.
party_identity: Existing ECI recognition observation only; historical organizational continuity and game mapping not approved.
